mentions.name: Seizu
mentions.description: Seizu is a RAG/MCP/agent service with workflows for security, built on top of Cartography, which pulls infrastructure and SaaS information into a Neo4j database with a standardized ontology to support attack path analysis, vulnerability assessment, and inventory. Seizu adds reporting, graph exploration, and automations on top of that RAG, including pre-made automations: automatic dependency vulnerability fixes that use codex/claude/opencode in a sandbox to assess whether dependency changes require code updates and auto-fix broken tests, a workflow for running Cartography syncs with split stages, parallel execution, and custom schedules, and a generic staged/parallel/chained AI agent workflow powered by Seizu's custom agent with broad LLM provider and sandbox support. Workflows are built on Temporal.
mentions.source_excerpt:
As a side project, I've been working on a RAG/MCP/agent service with workflows, for security: https://mappedsky.com/seizu/

This primarily builds on top of cartography (https://docs.cartography.dev/), which I'm a contributor to, which pulls infrastructure, SaaS, etc info into a Neo4j database, makes edges, and has a standardize ontology, so you can do attack path analysis, vulnerability assessment, inventory, etc.

Seizu uses the RAG built by cartography, and adds reporting, graph exploration, automations and more on-top of it.
mentions.author: ryan_lane
